blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Several Mindanao towns differed on whether to suspend or hold classes for World Teachers’ Day on Monday. In Talakag, Bukidnon, Mayor Renato Sulatan stood firm in his decision to suspend classes in the municipality for World Teachers’ Day on Monday, making it the only municipality in the province to do so. On his personal social media page, the mayor stated that the break gives students, teachers, and school personnel time to rest, recharge, and celebrate.
